gate.require_nonempty: %(name)s: %(what)s is empty. An empty input is not "all pass" — either the collection logic is broken or the path is wrong. Fix the input, do not switch the gate off.
gate.spec_unreadable: %(path)s cannot be read / is not valid JSON: %(error)s
gate.env_hint:
found %(file)s, but this process set no knob at all — criteria may fall back to default names and differ from the hook context.
       try running it with %(file)s:
         set -a; . %(file)s; set +a
       (or pass the knob explicitly: `REFLECT_*=<value> python3 ...`)
gate.never_falsifiable_or: `or <truthy constant>` — the boolean is short-circuited by a constant, always PASS
gate.never_falsifiable_and: `and <falsy constant>` — the boolean is short-circuited by a constant, always fail
gate.never_falsifiable_self_compare: both sides of the comparison are the same expression — always true (x == x)
gate.selftest_empty_cases: the selftest case list for %(name)s is empty — all three tiers of cases are mandatory (0/0 is not a pass, it means "this selftest checked nothing")
gate.platform_root: Gate platform. Repo root under check: %(root)s
gate.platform_usage: Usage: in your checker `from gate import selftest, require_nonempty`.
gate.module_banner: the gate platform is a module (it provides selftest / require_nonempty / finish; it consumes none) — it does not run standalone.
